Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Latin1

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Latin1
public class Latin1 extends Object
Latin 1-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_LATIN1 section of /usr/include/X11/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x00.
